notes: SIDE MENU THAT FOLDS: Fold menu at the bottom folds it to icons and opens it again; each section heading folds with a click; in a narrow window or with large text it folds by itself. Also in 1.8.0, if this computer has not had it: corrections of dates, numbers and cheque numbers; typed bill numbering while the books are cleaned; Bills to check; restore shows what a backup is missing; each computer keeps its own backup folder; filing margin on receipts and invoices. Take a backup first: Setup, Backup, Back up now. No upgrade of the books: backups move freely between 1.7.0, 1.8.0 and 1.8.1.
